WHY THE STARSHIP CATCH CHANGES EVERYTHING

Catching the Super Heavy booster with the tower arms isn’t just a flex — it’s the key that unlocks true rapid reusability.

Here’s why it matters:
• Turnaround speed
Ocean or droneship landings still require recovery ships, transport, and heavy refurbishment. Catching the booster directly at the launch tower means it can potentially be restacked and flown again in hours or days instead of weeks.
• Cost
The rocket itself is the most expensive part of spaceflight. Rapid reuse with minimal work is what drives cost per kilogram toward Starship’s target of under $100/kg.
• Flight cadence
A multiplanetary future requires flying often. High cadence only becomes realistic when the booster can be caught and turned around quickly.
• Closing the loop
Falcon 9 proved reuse works. Starship aims for both stages to be fully and rapidly reusable. The tower catch is the biggest remaining milestone for the first stage.
This is the difference between a reusable rocket and a rapidly reusable rocket.
Everything else — Mars, the Moon, orbital industry — gets much closer once you can catch the booster and fly it again fast.
The catch isn’t the end goal.

BREAKING: Grok 4.5 just claimed the top spot on the new HighWalk Benchmark.

The independent test measures how well AI models update real technical specifications from 46 Laravel commits — heavy on code analysis, abstraction, and precise writing.

STARSHIP IS STILL FLOATING
More than four days after its controlled splashdown, Starship is still sitting in the Indian Ocean.
SpaceX is now sending a vessel out to recover it.
Every successful splashdown + recovery gets them closer to rapid reuse.
The hard part isn’t just flying it.
It’s bringing it back and flying it again.

Tesla FSD Supervised is 5.2× safer than human drivers in Europe

In the last ~4 months, FSD Supervised logged 65 million kilometers across five EU countries (Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia & Lithuania) and delivered:

• 5.2× fewer collisions
• 13.4× less automatic emergency braking
• 9.2× less harsh acceleration
• 7.1× less harsh braking
• 7.6× fewer hard swerves
Real-world data, same roads, same timeframe. The numbers speak for themselves.
